method: Web research 2026-10-15 from search-engine summaries of the cited pages (pages not opened directly). Most support evidence is McKinsey's own recruiting content.
overview: McKinsey & Company is a global strategy and management consulting firm advising senior leaders across industries and functions, including a large sustainability practice. Undergraduates join as Business Analysts; Associate is the post-MBA title.

differentiators.text: Generalist model: business analysts are staffed across industries and functions, with a professional-development manager helping match projects to their priorities.
differentiators.significance: Broad early exposure, including sustainability work, before specialising.

early_career.text: Business analysts get strengths-based coaching and frequent mentoring, including a senior colleague from their office or practice.
early_career.significance: Structured mentorship is documented; quality varies by mentor.

employee_support.text: Expanded firm-wide parental leave in most regions with a reintegration program so returning colleagues can keep their career progress.
employee_support.significance: Addresses the career penalty of leave, not just its length.

employee_support.text: 'Ramp Off, Ramp On' provides mentorship and workload adjustment for people leaving for or returning from leave.

flexibility.text: Take Time lets consultants take up to 10 extra weeks of unpaid leave a year between projects; part-time programs (reduced days or hours) exist, with 850+ consultants reported on them.
flexibility.significance: Real structural options; older reporting suggests they're used occasionally, not routinely.

tradeoffs.text: Independent 2014 reporting described long hours as the norm, with flexibility programs as an exception used occasionally across a career.
tradeoffs.significance: Dated; ask current analysts about typical weeks and travel.

unknowns: Typical weekly hours and travel for NYC business analysts in 2026.
Length of US paid parental leave.
